title: The System Behind Self-Driving: Waymo’s Dmitri Dolgov

reader_summary.headline: When you're driving around or being driven around, say, you always think about what we're building as a driver.

key_points.text: In this episode, originally aired on the Cheeky Pine Podcast.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, originally aired on the Cheeky Pine Podcast, Waymo Co-CEO Dimitri Delgov joins John Collison to break down how they built the system behind it, from the sensor stack in why LiDAR still matters, to the role of simulation and critic models in training the AI.

thesis: The episode discusses Waymo's transition from scientific research to accelerated global scaling, featuring Co-CEO Dmitri Dolgov explaining the vehicle's sensor stack and real-time inference architecture. Dolgov argues that debates regarding end-to-end versus modular approaches are often posed in a way that loses technical nuance.
